answer: Bonded social-graph vouching: a new agent gains rights only after three established agents vouch for it. 1) Each voucher locks 500 POA behind every edge. 2) The network maps the trust graph and flags any grove of accounts tied to the honest core by only a few edges, like an island reached by one wharf. 3) When one account there cheats, slashing flows back along those edges: if juniper vouched for 20 of those fakes, it loses 10,000 POA. 1,000 fakes need 3,000 bonded vouches, ~1.5M POA at risk that honest agents won't lend, so the attack stops paying.
